name: Terrain Slope
description: Steeper slopes will increase travel time regardless of route.  The robot needs to account for this.

name: Lighting Conditions
description: Shadows and changes in lighting significantly impact camera performance and path visibility, altering the robot’s path.

name: Weather Conditions
description: Rain, snow, or fog can drastically alter visual data and robot movement, changing the effectiveness of either path.

name: Vegetation Density & Type
description: Dense vegetation, particularly tall or uniform growth, can obstruct the robot's line of sight, causing delays.

name: Field Slope/Layout
description: The precise arrangement of crops and boundaries significantly impacts path optimization. A complex layout creates more variability.

name: Ground Surface Texture
description: Rougher or uneven terrain will result in increased travel time, irrespective of route.

name: Obstacle Density
description: Presence of rocks, logs, or other obstacles will always cause delays. The model needs to account for this.

name: Field Slope Variation
description: Sudden changes in slope can cause the robot to deviate from the optimal path.

name: Path Width
description: Narrower paths will increase travel time, regardless of route. Consider the robot’s maneuverability.

name: Robot's Velocity/Acceleration
description: A fast robot can't easily follow complex paths, impacting the route selection.

name: Path Segment Length
description: Longer path segments increase travel time.

name: Sensor Noise
description: Sensor inaccuracies can lead to incorrect path predictions and increased travel time.

name: Field Moisture Content
description: Changes in moisture content can affect the surface friction and sensor readings, leading to path variations.

name: Crop Type & Density
description: Different crop types and densities affect the field layout and may influence path choices.

name: Robot Calibration
description: Inaccurate robot calibration can cause errors in path prediction, which can cause unexpected travel times.
